highlights: New AI Sidekick: Brings a more capable in-product AI chat for creating pipelines, debugging failed runs, navigating chat threads, tracking subagent progress, and using Sidekick from editor workflows with more reliable production routing.
New Terminal with autocomplete and version control: Adds terminal autocomplete, Git authentication, reconnect handling, prompt metadata, and production routing hardening.
MFA and account security: Consolidates MFA setup, required sign-in verification, account-settings placement, lockout handling, and migration safety.
Monitoring, logs, and observability: Adds OpenSearch-backed global log search, overview monitoring, pipeline monitoring, schedule heatmaps, and alerting improvements.
Pipeline operations: Improves project-wide retry actions, date filters, trigger search, run links, and run-status workflows.
Pipeline authoring and templates: Expands template browsing and creation, pipeline-file scope, custom syntax themes, dynamic-block output support, and editor polish.

releases.title: Mage Pro Release Notes

highlights: **Multiplayer pipeline editor:** Real-time collaborative pipeline editing, live presence avatars, and per-block edit locks help prevent lost work from concurrent edits.
**AI Sidekick improvements:** "Fix with AI" is more discoverable for failed runs and blocks, with streamlined UX for logs, pipeline runs, and pipeline editor integration.
**New workspace capabilities:** Customizable landing page, improved "New Pipeline" creation, block visibility tabs, and persistent left navigation in the pipeline editor.
**End-to-end trigger and run management upgrades:** Cancel all active pipeline runs, bulk-disable all triggers, and improved Microsoft Ads/Google Ads/BigQuery and Salesforce Marketing Cloud sources.
**Mage Pro release notes:** Release changelogs now published and visible in the UI for every Mage Pro image.

**Cloud agent dev: EKS-only, improved slots, live QA URLs:** Hardens AWS/EKS dev slot process, fast file transfer for remote slots, improved status reporting, and QA credentials for feature test/visual QA.
